items.title: The flat at a point functor is unchanged by a flat local extension of the target
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter flat.tex (More on Flatness)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file flat.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that the functor of points where a module is flat at a point is unchanged when the local algebra is replaced by a flat local extension and the module is extended along it (statement lines 6107-6115, tag 05II-adjacent). The proof works after an arbitrary base change: it rewrites the two relevant closed sets as spectra of tensor products of residue fields, observes that the induced map between them is surjective by faithful flatness, and then uses descent of flatness along the flat local extension to equate the two flatness conditions, concluding formally. The identification of the loci and the descent step are the substance, so the claim is H2.
